description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to storage version migration, including structs for migration objects, their specifications, statuses, and list collections, along with associated constants and metadata annotations.

classes.name: StorageVersionMigration
classes.description: Represents a migration of stored data to the latest storage version.

classes.name: StorageVersionMigrationStatus
classes.description: Holds the current status and conditions of the migration.

classes.name: StorageVersionMigrationList
classes.description: A collection of storage version migration objects.
